title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
inputFormat:
Implement codecRoundTrip(root). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
Trees use level-order arrays with null for missing children. The editor passes nodes with val, left, and right properties; [] becomes null.
outputFormat:
Return the result described in the statement.
Returned trees are displayed as level-order arrays, trimming trailing nulls.
